app.developerRequired: Enable developer mode to use this demo tool.
app.developerDisabled: Developer mode is disabled. Enable it and try again.
app.clearChatDescription: This clears the conversation for all browsers and starts a new chat. Banking data, audit logs and run records are preserved. Finish pending operations before clearing.
app.chatResetBlocked: The conversation changed or has unfinished work. Finish pending operations, refresh and try again.
app.chatResetFailed: The conversation could not be cleared. Refresh and try again.
app.assistantDescription: Your everyday banking, in one conversation.
transport.failed: The request could not be completed. Reload the conversation to check its status.
transport.randomUnavailable: This browser cannot create a request ID. Use a current browser and try again.
help.title: Start a banking task in your own words
help.description: Describe your request, then review the details. Tasks that need approval or verification show an operation panel.
help.step.describe.title: Describe your request
help.step.describe.body: Specify the task, recipient and amount or units. The assistant asks for missing details.
help.step.review.title: Review and approve
help.step.review.body: Check the recipient, account or card, and amount. Enter a verification code in the operation panel when required.
help.step.result.title: Check the result
help.step.result.body: Use the operation panel and business records to check the outcome. More details are in Activity.
help.exampleHint: An example only fills the composer. Edit it before sending.
help.examplesUnavailable: Examples are unavailable while you have a draft or a task is being processed. Close help to continue your current task.
help.feature.accounts.title: Accounts and statements
help.feature.accounts.body: Check balances, transactions, spending categories and unusual transactions. Business pages are also in navigation.
help.feature.accounts.example: Show this month's spending categories and unusual transactions
help.feature.transfer.title: Transfers
help.feature.transfer.body: Find a recipient by name or full phone number. The approval card shows the recipient, payment account and amount.
help.feature.transfer.example: Transfer CNY 200 to 张伟 with the note lunch
help.feature.investment.title: Investments
help.feature.investment.body: Check products and holdings. Subscribe by amount and redeem by units. Review the settlement amount in the operation panel.
help.feature.investment.example: Show my units and returns for 稳健理财A
help.feature.cards.title: Card management
help.feature.cards.body: Temporarily lock or unlock cards, report loss, replace cards and apply for virtual cards. Spending category limits do not change credit limits. Formal loss reports cannot be reversed.
help.feature.cards.example: Show the status and available amounts of my cards
help.feature.subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
help.feature.subscriptions.body: Check subscription charges and renewal dates. Cancellation details are shown for approval before execution.
help.feature.subscriptions.example: Show active subscription charges and upcoming renewals
help.feature.schedules.title: Scheduled tasks
help.feature.schedules.body: Specify the date, time and task. Use Check due on Scheduled tasks or run the scheduler. Tasks that require approval or verification still need it.
help.security.green: Automatic: balance and statement queries generally need no additional approval.
help.security.yellow: Approval: transfers and subscription cancellations show details for you to approve first.
help.security.red: Verification: large transfers, investment subscriptions and card loss reports also require a code. Transfer risk changes with the daily total.
help.securityResult: A missing operation panel or a pending approval or verification status does not mean success. If the result needs reconciliation, check the records before submitting again.
help.demoBody: Accounts and money are simulated. Tasks update the demo database and do not move real money. Codes are for demonstration; no real SMS is sent. Do not enter real banking passwords or SMS codes.
help.reopenHint: Once closed, this guide will not reopen automatically. Open Usage help anytime.
